notes: EBIT definition: For this package, EBIT is proxied as 'income from operations' (operating income) from Alphabet’s consolidated statements. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

D&A definition: Alphabet’s cash flow statement provides 'Depreciation of property and equipment' (not a separate amortization line). The package uses this as D&A proxy. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))
Capex definition: capex equals 'Purchases of property and equipment' (absolute value). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

NWC construction (approximation): NWC is modeled as (Accounts receivable, net + Other current assets) minus Total current liabilities. This is a simplified working-capital proxy and may differ from a debt-excluded or cash-excluded operational NWC definition used elsewhere in DCF pipelines. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204425000014/goog-20241231.htm))

Investments field: 'investments' is set to current marketable securities only (excludes non-marketable securities). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

Debt definition: 'debt' includes long-term debt plus the current portion of long-term notes as presented in the FY2025 debt footnote (commercial paper was zero at 12/31/2025). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

NOL balance: 'nol_balance' is set to the sum of federal, state, and foreign net operating loss carryforwards disclosed in the FY2025 tax note (utilization is not directly specified). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

NOL utilization: 'nol_utilization_pct' is a modeling assumption (0.25) because the filing indicates the majority is not likely realized rather than providing a specific utilization schedule. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

Comps gap: EV/NTM Revenue, EV/NTM EBITDA, and P/E NTM were not available from the primary/official sources collected in a consistent, peer-by-peer manner; therefore peer multiple fields are null and should be populated from a market-data provider (e.g., FactSet/Capital IQ/Bloomberg) if required by the pipeline.

WACC gap: WACC (0.09 base) is a modeling assumption selected for a large, investment-grade profile; replace with your pipeline’s standard WACC methodology if it expects internally consistent cost-of-equity and cost-of-debt inputs.

catalysts: AI product adoption and improved monetization translating into sustained operating leverage (margin durability around the modeled target). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

Google Cloud execution (service revenue growth) supporting continued top-line compounding as modeled in the forecast ramp. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

Further regulatory/legal outcomes from the Dec 2025 judgment and related appeals that could change distribution economics. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))
company_overview: Alphabet operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets, with revenues primarily driven by advertising and cloud services. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

Reported operating income (EBIT proxy) rose from $84.3B (2023) to $129.0B (2025), supported by scale and cost management across segments. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

The company maintains significant liquidity via cash, marketable securities, and ongoing operating cash flow. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))
current_context: FY2025: revenue $402.8B and operating income $129.0B; operating cash flow was $164.7B. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

FY2025 capex increased sharply to $91.4B; management expects a significant increase in technical infrastructure investment in 2026 relative to 2025. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

Ongoing regulatory developments remain a key near-term overhang (final antitrust judgment in Dec 2025; appeal actions noted in the FY2025 10-K). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))
investment_highlights: Base-case growth tapers from 12% (2026) to 7% (2030), reflecting a large-scale advertising + cloud platform with continued AI monetization. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

EBIT margin is modeled to stabilize around ~32% (target ~32.8%) in line with FY2024-2025 operating income versus revenue. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

Capex intensity remains elevated in the base case but gradually declines as a percent of sales, consistent with FY2023-2025 capex behavior and the 2026 infrastructure ramp described by management. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

Net working capital is modeled as negative (cash conversion support), consistent with Alphabet’s negative NWC approximation from current assets vs current liabilities. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204425000014/goog-20241231.htm))
key_risks: Higher-than-expected AI infrastructure spending could pressure free cash flow and margins if revenue monetization lags. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

Ad-tech and search distribution regulatory restrictions could structurally impact growth and margins versus the base case. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

Working-capital dynamics could move less favorably (less negative NWC), increasing net capital required for growth. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204425000014/goog-20241231.htm))

presentation.subtitle: Alphabet (GOOGL) DCF valuation input package (base case + bull/bear)
valuation_summary: DCF base case is built from explicit 5-year drivers (growth, EBIT margin, D&A/capex intensity, and working capital intensity) anchored to FY2023-2025 fundamentals. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

Terminal value uses an exit-multiple approach with economically plausible long-run growth (3.0%) and a single terminal EBITDA multiple assumption. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))

Capital structure adjustments (cash, debt, and minority interest) are taken from the FY2025 balance sheet to bridge from enterprise value to equity value inputs. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000018/goog-20251231.htm))
